text:
mira: Heads up — I just saw the console briefly show another org's project list when I switched roles quickly. Repro steps: switch to admin role -> quick org switch -> open sidebar. It flashes other org rows for ~1s then corrects.

kai: ugh. Any chance this is just a stale DOM render or an actual API returning wrong data?

mira: It's the API. Captured network trace — the prefetch endpoint returned a payload with org_id: 89012 while the header X-Org-ID: 12345 was present in the request.

anjali: wait — request had X-Org-ID=12345 but body org_id=89012? That sounds like cached prefetch keyed by something else (route cookie?)

mira: exact. Prefetch key uses route+user, not org. Rapid org changes cause the same cache key to be reused across orgs until TTL expires.

ops-bot: deploy 2026-03-21T12:04:21Z: prefetch-service v2.3.1 rolled in prod to 3/5 canaries.

tj: could be the routing policy handshake between console and prefetch sidecar — affinity cookie (AFF_ID) is sticky and not cleared when org changes. If AFF_ID is in the cache key, it might point at wrong precomputed snapshot.

sarah: telemetry shows a small spike in requests with missing or mismatched org header around 12:03-12:06 UTC yesterday. Counted ~120 such events cluster per minute during rapid role-testing by QA.

mira: repro snippet from DevTools:
```
GET /api/prefetch?route=sidebar&user=mk
Host: console.internal
X-Org-ID: 12345
Cookie: AFF_ID=ab12cd
Response: 200
{"org_id":89012, "items": [...]}
```

kai: hmm. So prefetch response contains an org_id field from cached snapshot. Cache key currently: `route:${route}|aff:${AFF_ID}|user:${user}` — that's the bug. Org must be part of key.

anjali: agree. Two mitigation options: 1) fast hotfix — include org in cache key and purge relevant cache entries on canary, or 2) invalidate cache on org-switch event at frontend (cheap but increases backend load).

tj: frontend invalidation will mask other problems. We should fix server-side key to be `route:${route}|org:${org}|user:${user}`. Breaking change? Cache entries will miss until warmed. OK for low traffic routes.

kai: also add a defensive header check: prefetch-service should assert that response.org_id === request.X-Org-ID and log+drop/mask if mismatch to avoid flashing wrong org in UI.

mira: I can open a quick PR for the header assertion and instrumentation. Will add a metric `prefetch.mismatch_org` and sample payload IDs.

sarah: add an alert if mismatch_rate > 0.1% for 5m. We should know if any live customers saw it.

anjali: test plan: unit for cache-key change, integration deploy to staging with AFF_ID replay to ensure no cross-org hits, e2e where we do 100 rapid org switches and assert no cross-org rows.

tj: canary plan: rollout to prefetch nodes in one region first, monitor `prefetch.mismatch_org` and `cache.miss_rate` for 10m, then full prod.

kai: I'm taking the cache-key change. Will open PR referencing this thread and add migration notes. @mira please add the assertion/telemetry PR. @sarah please add the alert on metrics.

mira: on it. I'll include a quick manual script to purge stale keys in Redis for the last 2 days just in case.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-045 — console prefetched snapshots crossing org boundary (assigned to kai).

kai: pulling this into my sprint today. ETA for PR tomorrow EOD. If anyone on-call sees org flashes in console, please post traces here. :eyes:

mira: thanks all, will post the staging repro link once assertion PR is up.
